# Alpha diversity comparison

本节将不同品种和不同 `FUT1` 基因型的 Alpha 多样性比较拼成一幅图，仅展示 `Chao1`、`Shannon` 和 `Simpson` 指标。

## 载入包

```{r}
#| label: alpha-diversity-load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(microeco)
library(patchwork)

theme_set(theme_bw())
```

## 计算 Alpha 多样性

```{r}
#| label: alpha-diversity-prepare-data
otu_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/otu_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
sample_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/sample_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
    breed = factor(breed, levels = c("Duroc", "Landrace", "Yorkshire")),
    genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("AA", "GA", "GG"))
  )
taxon_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/taxon_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

mt <- microtable$new(
  otu_table = otu_table,
  sample_table = sample_table,
  tax_table = taxon_table
)
mt$tidy_dataset()

alpha_measures <- c("Chao1", "Shannon", "Simpson")
mt$cal_alphadiv(measures = alpha_measures)

alpha_data <- mt$alpha_diversity |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("sample") |>
  left_join(
    mt$sample_table |> as.data.frame() |> rownames_to_column("sample"),
    by = "sample"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(alpha_measures), names_to = "Index", values_to = "Value") |>
  mutate(Index = factor(Index, levels = alpha_measures))

significance_label <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

pairwise_significance <- function(data, group_var) {
  group_levels <- levels(droplevels(data[[group_var]]))
  comparisons <- combn(group_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  empty_result <- tibble(
    Index = factor(levels = levels(data$Index)),
    group1 = character(),
    group2 = character(),
    p_value = numeric(),
    p_adjust = numeric(),
    label = character(),
    x = numeric(),
    xend = numeric(),
    y = numeric(),
    y_text = numeric(),
    tick = numeric()
  )

  result <- map_dfr(levels(data$Index), function(index_name) {
    index_data <- data |> filter(Index == index_name)
    y_range <- range(index_data$Value, na.rm = TRUE)
    y_span <- diff(y_range)
    if (!is.finite(y_span) || y_span == 0) {
      y_span <- max(y_range[2], 0.01)
    }

    tests <- map_dfr(comparisons, function(pair) {
      x1 <- index_data |> filter(.data[[group_var]] == pair[1]) |> pull(Value)
      x2 <- index_data |> filter(.data[[group_var]] == pair[2]) |> pull(Value)

      tibble(
        group1 = pair[1],
        group2 = pair[2],
        p_value = wilcox.test(x1, x2, exact = FALSE)$p.value
      )
    }) |>
      mutate(
        p_adjust = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
        label = significance_label(p_adjust)
      ) |>
      filter(!is.na(label)) |>
      arrange(p_adjust)

    if (nrow(tests) == 0) {
      return(empty_result)
    }

    tests |>
      mutate(
        Index = index_name,
        x = match(group1, group_levels),
        xend = match(group2, group_levels),
        y = y_range[2] + y_span * (0.04 + row_number() * 0.055),
        y_text = y + y_span * 0.018,
        tick = y_span * 0.018
      )
  })

  bind_rows(empty_result, result) |>
    mutate(Index = factor(Index, levels = levels(data$Index)))
}
```

## Alpha diversity figure

```{r}
#| label: fig-alpha-diversity-combined
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-asp: 1
#| fig-cap: "不同品种和不同 FUT1 基因型的 Alpha 多样性比较。上排为品种比较，下排为基因型比较；三列依次为 Chao1、Shannon 和 Simpson。"
plot_alpha_panel <- function(data, group_var, x_label, show_x_title = FALSE) {
  sig_data <- pairwise_significance(data, group_var)

  data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[group_var]], y = Value, fill = .data[[group_var]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.65) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.16, size = 0.55, alpha = 0.65) +
    geom_segment(
      data = sig_data,
      aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = sig_data,
      aes(x = x, xend = x, y = y - tick, yend = y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = sig_data,
      aes(x = xend, xend = xend, y = y - tick, yend = y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = sig_data,
      aes(x = (x + xend) / 2, y = y_text, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 2
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Index, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.14))) +
    labs(x = if (show_x_title) x_label else NULL, y = "Alpha diversity") +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 6),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 7),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

breed_plot <- plot_alpha_panel(alpha_data, "breed", "Breed")
genotype_plot <- plot_alpha_panel(alpha_data, "genotype", "FUT1 genotype", show_x_title = TRUE)

breed_plot / genotype_plot +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
```
